title: t27c on fifo.t27 -- break a flag, one test objects
desc: push sets flags.empty = false; one sed flips it to true and push_increments_fill fails on the next run; git restores the spec.
commands: sed -i '' 's/result.flags.empty = false;/result.flags.empty = true;/' specs/fpga/fifo.t27 && git diff -U0 specs/fpga/fifo.t27 | tail -n 2
